scope: Native DOOP manual-joins, release, sm_89 materialized cubin, warm dependency artifacts. One machine; not a clean workspace build or a multi-workload speed guarantee.
method: Serial builds under an exclusive machine timing lock. Times are external wall seconds, excluding lock acquisition, unless indicated. The capture rustc wrapper records which units actually ran: Cargo can replay the previous -Ztime-passes output for a fresh library.

generated_rule_edit.edit: Remove VPT_LoadField@2 from print_rounds frontier scheduling; same relational result, different generated CUDA traversal.
generated_rule_edit.incremental_unchanged_ptx_entries: 285 of 286 had identical names and bodies after normalizing comments, self references, whitespace, and local basic-block labels.
generated_rule_edit.shard_boundary: Run the existing checked frontend to the Round printer. Materialize standalone rule functions, their packed type aliases, and the engine body. Pass the selected rule to the engine through a concrete Rust function pointer. Build its body on the executable side of the crate boundary; retain the other rules in the engine rlib. Rewrite only files whose contents changed.
generated_rule_edit.changed_output: Only __cq_gpu_hole_131.rs changed among 139 standalone functions, the aliases and engine tail. This prototype chooses the editable rule in advance; it is not a general automatic partitioner.
generated_rule_edit.repeat_full_edit_includes: Measured in one invocation: run checked plan generation from edited source, render/update sources, Cargo release build and executable link. No incremental rustc flag. Final executable SHA-256 279ea2e0b4241bd7981c7eb14c5714f6392e254fab07fcf4aa8fd3bfe2096382.

validation.xalan: Edited monolith and shard each matched the CPU reference's full tuples for all 26 outputs.

handwritten_rule_edit.edit: Reverse the order in which expand_pairs consumes VPT_LoadArray@3 pair descriptors. Each descriptor still writes its own reserved output range. Identical edited manual.rs in both arms.
handwritten_rule_edit.validation: Both variants passed Xalan exact tuples for all 26 outputs and Scala cardinalities digest 75b7003b twice, in split/monolith/monolith/split order.
handwritten_rule_edit.scope: Same engine/rule boundary; no checked source generation needed for this hand-written rule edit.

host_codegen.audit: Of 286 host kernel symbols, 210 private generated entry addresses were referenced only by discard-only black_box calls in PTX-name helpers. Retain device MIR, launch identity, and host ABI. Replace only these audited host definitions with distinct traps before host LLVM optimization; leave the other 76 entries unchanged. The interposer is an experiment, not a supported compiler interface.
host_codegen.verification: Device IR also byte-identical. Both arms passed Xalan full tuples (26 outputs) and Scala output cardinalities twice.

fast_host_flags_runtime.metric: driver-reported Scala GPU evaluation seconds including host work; alternating trials, identical output counts

device_partition_replay.scope: Saved LLVM IR to PTX only, including input processing, parallel opt/llc and merge; AB/BA means. Not a whole build.
